K3.reason: pycore/pyutils/common/client_key_auth.py is the single pycore signer and verifier. Values come from service_contract.json#client_key_auth (import fails if the error codes or clients drift); path and query go through relay_contract.canonical_path/canonical_query. The signing key is CORE_NODE_CLIENT_KEY_1; verifiers accept only _1.._5 by key id. A missing key yields no headers (Laravel answers client_key_missing) and one log line naming the secret and the dd step, never the value. The nonce is recorded after the HMAC check in a serialized ledger with the contract TTL.

PR-014.reason: laravel_client.request encodes params into the URL and form fields into the body (requests-compatible) before signing, so the signed query and body digest are the exact wire bytes. JSON is serialized once, multipart signs UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD, and a non-bytes body raises instead of signing str(dict). All pycore -> Laravel calls go through this gateway; include_default_identity is gone, so relay calls are signed too, which enables the route table's auto-claim of device-enrollments.

PR-003.reason: workspace_auth.py (the committed bearer secret) and common/http_auth.py are deleted. Every workspace route takes the K3 result (verified once per request and cached on the ASGI scope by rpc_v2/http/client_key_request.py, so the gate and the route never consume a nonce twice). Outbound CodeSync peer calls (peer_mesh, server_connection, client, manager, http_client SSE/POST, discovery) are signed through runtime.signed_peer_request, and docs_fix/CODESYNC_AI_COMMUNICATION_API.md describes the signed flow. No UI calls the workspace routes.

cross_end: Scratchpad check on a copy of client_key_auth.py with only the imports stubbed (and the real relay canonical_path/canonical_query methods extracted): the key id, all 3 canonical strings and signatures of test_vectors.json reproduce; client_key_headers -> client_key_verify round trips ok, a replay gives client_key_nonce_replayed, and a tampered query gives client_key_signature_invalid. With Laravel (laravel-T1) and ncore (ncore-1) reproducing the same vectors, all three ends agree.
